name: recall
description: Local-first knowledge layer for coding agents: learns from your agent sessions, verifies against your repo, and injects context back — via Claude Code hooks, MCP, and compiled rules.

scripts.build:hook: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun build --compile hookbin/recall-hook.ts --outfile hookbin/recall-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '(bun not found; hooks will use the Node fallback)'
